historical_reviews.deepseek: Names and readings omit units, status, thresholds, presence, redundancy, physical association and freshness, so they cannot prove all information or safe cooling state.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly changes the narrow read into a complete protected fan-inventory comparison while forbidding workload or fan-control stimulation.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Fan readings are meaningful only when bound to a physical rotor and time. A plausible RPM without units, timestamp, status or redundancy role can be stale, mapped to another fan or insufficient for the cooling topology.

original_test_intent: Validate the complete same-chassis fan inventory and live health data against the approved SPEC, including physical membership, readings, units, thresholds, status, redundancy and freshness, without controlling fans or creating thermal load.
original_method: Bind every BMC fan member to a physical slot/label, capture the full protected Thermal/Fans representation and synchronized UI evidence, compare population, reading/unit, status/health, thresholds, redundancy group and freshness to the owner matrix, optionally correlate approved same-target SDR data, and confirm the read caused no fan, thermal or power change.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the physical fan and threshold matrix; an operator confirms UI-only labels or platform exceptions and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Expected fan population and physical slot/label map
Reading units and acceptable range policy
Vendor Thermal/Fans schema and UI mapping
safety_requirements: Do not change fan modes, curves, thresholds or power policy
Do not generate workload to move readings
Validate exact chassis and physical mapping
Require unit, timestamp and status with every reading
Stop interpretation on critical health, missing fan, stale data or mapping ambiguity
Preserve raw and UI evidence without clearing logs
Do not automatically retry inconsistent telemetry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact target and fan resource
Capture complete raw fan inventory and synchronized UI evidence
Map logical entries to physical locations
Normalize and compare all required fields
engineer_actions: Approve fan population, mapping and threshold policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Thermal GET is relevant discovery, but the two-field projection, unsafe `-k`/inline credentials and lack of units, status, thresholds, mapping and freshness cannot satisfy the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected full Thermal/Fans or vendor member retrieval plus synchronized UI capture, then apply the approved physical/member/threshold/freshness matrix without controlling fans.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Fans information and 20/20-minute estimates remain; no stress or fan actuation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a per-fan ledger of stable resource identity, physical location, reading, unit, timestamp, health/status, thresholds, redundancy role and SPEC comparison, retaining full raw payloads.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a vague all-information display check into deterministic, topology-aware cooling evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Name and RPM alone do not prove presence, health, thresholds, redundancy or data freshness.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fans may share labels or be represented by aggregate controllers; transient zero readings and cached UI require vendor semantics and timestamps before fault interpretation.

project_override_considerations: The Project must publish the fitted fan population, physical label map, units/thresholds and redundancy behavior. Physical fault injection or fan removal is outside this inventory-only row.
expected_evidence: Exact BMC/SUT/chassis identity, UI/firmware version and approved fan/member/physical matrix
Complete protected raw Fans payload and synchronized UI capture
Per-fan location, reading, unit, timestamp, health/status, threshold and redundancy comparison
Missing, extra, duplicate, stale, unavailable and malformed report
Optional same-target SDR correlation and no-control-mutation proof
Thermal/audit/SEL review, exceptions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require Fans information versus SPEC. DeepSeek undercovers the required fields but does not introduce a competing Master scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The fan matrix, physical mapping and vendor schema are normal project inputs; the read-only method is clear and safe once they are supplied.

review_improvement: Replaces two-field telemetry with complete, physically mapped, freshness-aware fan inventory and health evidence while preserving a no-stimulus boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cooling validation requires topology as well as telemetry. The same numeric reading can be valid for one rotor and unsafe for another, while cached or aggregate values can mask a missing member. Physical mapping, units, timestamps, status and redundancy semantics make each observation interpretable without perturbing the thermal system.
